snippet.title: Agefield High: Rock the School - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Agefield High: Rock the School is available now on Steam. It will be available on consoles at a later date. Check out the Agefield High: Rock the School launch trailer for this adventure game. Relive your High School days in the town of Agefield. It’s the early 2000s, and graduation is on the horizon. REBEL with your friends, win over your dream girl and ROCK the school! A coming-of-age adventure about friendship, love, and rebellion inspired by the raunchy teen comedies of the era.

#ign #gaming
